annotations.title: Detach a service the tenant supplied

description: Give an alias back to the platform. If a human already filled the value in, the attachment and the variable both go; if it is still waiting for one, the declaration goes with it and the project stops asking. The tenant's own service is untouched — the platform never ran it and holds nothing of it to delete.
name: detach_external
title: Detach a service the tenant supplied
